channel.description: Latest articles from HeyNortheast Media Private Limited (thenewsmill.com)

item.title: PM Modi Forms Seven Groups to Manage Fuel Supply Amid Conflict
item.description: Prime Minister Modi announces seven empowered groups to strategize fuel and gas supply management in India amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.

item.title: Kerala Has Not Requested Central Aid for Fast Track Courts
item.description: Kerala has not submitted a proposal for central assistance to establish Fast Track Courts for NDPS cases, according to the Minister of State for Home Affairs.

item.title: Seeti Hosts Meghalaya Chapter from March 26 to 31, 2026
item.description: Seeti's Meghalaya chapter will showcase local food and culture from March 26-31, featuring chefs and storytellers from across India in an immersive experience.

item.title: Election Commission Accepts Rajeev Chandrasekhar's Nomination in Kerala
item.description: BJP's Rajeev Chandrasekhar receives nomination approval for Kerala's April 9 elections amid allegations from UDF regarding asset disclosure.

item.title: NHRC Investigates Deaths of Nine in Palam Fire in Delhi
item.description: The NHRC is probing the tragic deaths of nine family members in a Palam fire, raising serious human rights concerns and seeking reports from Delhi officials.

item.title: Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu Lead India in 2026 Thomas & Uber Cup
item.description: India announces squads for the 2026 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in Denmark, featuring Lakshya Sen, PV Sindhu, and a mix of experienced and young players.

item.title: Delhi Budget 2026: Rs 103,700 Crore Focuses on Infrastructure
item.description: The 2026 Delhi budget totals Rs 103,700 crore, emphasizing infrastructure, sustainability, and social welfare initiatives for the city's development.

item.title: BJP MP Sigriwal Criticizes Opposition's Response to Modi's Speech
item.description: BJP MP Janardan Singh Sigriwal urges the opposition to accept PM Modi's positive appeals regarding the West Asia conflict during a Lok Sabha address.

item.title: KK Goswami Visits Ayodhya to Seek Lord Ram's Blessings
item.description: Actor KK Goswami visits Ayodhya for prayers and filming, expressing joy over seeking blessings from Lord Ram ahead of Ram Navami celebrations.

item.title: BEL and RRP Group Sign MoU for Defence Semiconductor Development
item.description: Bharat Electronics Limited and RRP Group signed an MoU to develop semiconductors and drones, enhancing India's defence exports and indigenous capabilities.
